-- Phase 2: implementations. Contracts and signatures are unchanged from Phase 1.

-- True when `name` is a single plain file name: non-empty, no path
-- separators, and not a parent or current directory reference.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../a.txt") == False
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  if name == ""
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Returns the text of `notes/name`. Untrusted names: any name that is not
-- plain, or any missing or unreadable file, yields "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else ""
    text
